text: ref_short_hash: split on last '@' so branch names containing '@' work

ref_short_hash now uses rsplit('@', 1) so a branch like release@2024 yields the real hash. Unit test extended plus an e2e test on a branch named release@2024 (TestEventRefs... test_ref_on_branch_containing_at_sign_is_live). Full scripts/dev/check green (158 tests).
